accepted_static_checks.conclusion: Backend domain calls validation during review and again before original execute_claimed. It rejects missing/Disabled/wrong-family selection, empty argv, foreign native cwd/policy/workspace paths, unelevated enforced networking, unsupported token permission profiles, MXC arg0 and invalid dedicated managed-network context. These listed incompatibilities are rejected before upstream proxy.run and before a durable R2 invocation marker; validation does not perform backend.start.

RestrictedToken/Elevated reuse frozen public unsupported_windows_restricted_token_sandbox_reason. Their full-access rejection matches upstream unsupported backend, rather than a blanket product narrowing. MXC directly selects WindowsMxc and retains legitimate Managed-Unrestricted/Disabled/External permissions, still requiring trusted full policy approval. Native preflight does not convert such profiles to a weaker policy.

Production provisioning only accepts explicit WindowsRestrictedToken/WindowsMxc and actual Environment::create with retained full options/factory/locked helper. Complete ExecParams are hashed with provisioning instance identity. Qualification/decorated constructor is nonproduction and production Workbench entry rejects it. Returned actual sandbox family is checked before provider delivery. Upstream refuses required-but-None selection before child spawn; no retry with sandbox None, replacement Core, or mock Started/EOF appears in reviewed code. MXC full access is original explicit policy, not fallback.

Original R2 execution fence validates actual executor Connection/Admission and saves invocation_started before the synchronous callback can spawn actual backend.start. Callback does not reenter the R2 fence. Handoff uses exact original ToolIdentity, dynamic clock and original live executor validation; loss after start returns CommitUnknown and retains genuine cleanup ownership. Process control validates same executor before/after effects and after encoding; a lost mutation receipt becomes Unknown without replay.

Resources index binds exact opaque original HostBinding and returns same Arc, bounded to 128 owner entries; first exact R2 host Arc cannot be replaced. One registry charges 16 pending/active/Unknown operations across ports. Job/provider acquisition and exact retirement share entries mutex. Original Storage dereferences its original Session runtime, and complete WorkbenchState moves/borrows its original Manager/runtime; native resources own no Core, Store, protected key or lease.

Invalid, incomplete or conflicting observations latch permanently and cannot be replaced by a later plausible fact. Background actual-process observer only enqueues complete original-sequence facts; original Core CAS is borrowed by trusted drain. CAS Conflict retains; uncertain CAS is read-reconciled only and not repeated. Historical exact invocation_started facts can be acknowledged after execution revocation without restoring grants. Actual Exited AND Closed are needed, output gaps cannot manufacture digest/EOF, and guest/deadline/Drop/trusted termination share one marker so uncertain termination is not retried.

Lazy catalog does not duplicate content owner and failed opening/panic remains sticky. Mutation borrows original Storage.prepare_write and StateSlot.require_writable. Gate checks surround administrative work and encoded delivery; late controller loss invalidates original catalog leases and emits correlated Unknown without rerunning action. Reserved IDs deduplicate. Scoped stop subscriptions are bounded, preserve original primary stop, invoke outside mutexes and keep admission closed even if a callback panics.

Host loopback TLS client and network server explicitly select ring via builder_with_provider, so these seams do not depend on ambiguous process-global provider selection when the unified native graph also enables aws_lc_rs. New ordinary host TLS test generates memory keys and binds loopback without Storage or DPAPI. Source check is not a TLS runtime receipt.

open_boundaries.conclusion: The new validator covers the enumerated deterministic sandbox incompatibilities. It is not a promise to precompute every network-proxy config/listener error, permission/path metadata change, helper launch error, or OS failure. Frozen upstream still validates/run-prepares its real proxy. MXC availability is deliberately not probed here because availability creates a native security environment. No claim that preflight Ok establishes a sandbox.

Native is_clean only checks registry/mailbox; it is not task destruction or OS-worker/scheduler join. Direct trusted caller must retain the original scheduler/backend and reachable cleanup until real cleanup/facts acknowledgment and non-Tokio shutdown. Strong registry-slot retention can remain indefinitely for lost prefix, no handle or uncertain facts; it must not be advertised as globally leak-free. Worker lifecycle has a separate active repair and is not approved by this static receipt.
